Program_Info.Program_Change_Info:
Version 3.3.2.15 - twelve more languages, eighteen in total.
- Croatian, Slovenian, Serbian, Bosnian, Montenegrin, Bulgarian, Macedonian, Albanian, Romanian, Turkish, Polish and Danish have been added. Interface, dialogs, scheduler and logs are translated, and every language comes with its own help page. - The program name follows the language: 3Kopier, 3Copy, 3Copier, 3Copiar, 3Kopieer, 3Copia, 3Kopiraj, 3Copiaza, 3Kopyala, 3Kopiuj. - The program folder is tidy: language files, help pages, settings and profiles now live in folders of their own. English.Char_Desc_2000:
S-IT-3Kopier is a Windows utility for recurring copy tasks. A single run handles up to three independent source-target pairs, which makes it easy to follow the 3-2-1 rule: keep the data on a NAS, on an external disk and in a cloud folder at the same time, with one click and one log.
The number of profiles is unlimited, and every profile can have a schedule of its own - daily at a fixed time, on selected weekdays, or every few hours. Runs that overlap are queued instead of being lost. A silent mode keeps scheduled runs out of the way; the program can work from the notification area and start with Windows.
What is copied stays an ordinary file. There is no archive format, no account and no cloud service in between - the copy can be opened, moved or restored with nothing but Explorer. Exclusion lists keep browser caches, temporary files and large image formats out of the way, and a per-job filter can limit a run to certain file types. Paths beyond the 260-character limit are shortened automatically instead of failing.
The interface, all dialogs, the scheduler, the logs and the help pages are available in 18 languages: German, English, French, Spanish, Dutch, Italian, Croatian, Slovenian, Serbian, Bosnian, Montenegrin, Bulgarian, Macedonian, Albanian, Romanian, Turkish, Polish and Danish. The program name follows the language. File names and settings stay the same everywhere, so switching language leaves profiles and filters untouched.
S-IT-3Kopier is freeware - no advertising, no time limit, no registration.
